definitions.explanation: moving down (a schedule, date, or deadline); postponing (to a later time)
borrowing (in arithmetic, when subtracting from a larger place value)

examples.japanese: ⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧⟦{時刻|じこく}→時刻：03270_jikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繰|く}り{下|さ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}する→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧。
⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{繰|く}り{下|さ}げになった。
examples.english: The game was postponed due to rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年金|ねんきん}→年金：04695_nenkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受給|じゅきゅう}⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}り{下|さ}げ⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can delay the start of receiving your pension.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}き{算|ざん}→引き算：05333_hikizan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繰|く}り{下|さ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}する→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧。
{繰|く}り{下|さ}げ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{概念|がいねん}→概念：04709_gainen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}する→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧。
{繰|く}り{下|さ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Calculations that require borrowing are difficult.

notes:
{繰|く}り{下|さ}げ is a noun derived from the verb {繰|く}り{下|さ}げる (to move down, to postpone). Like its antonym ⟦{繰|く}り{上|あ}げ→繰り上げる：07007_kuriageru⟧, it has scheduling and arithmetic uses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繰|く}り{下|さ}げ (schedule postponement)
- ⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繰|く}り{下|さ}げ (moving down the date)
- ⟦{年金|ねんきん}→年金：04695_nenkin⟧{繰|く}り{下|さ}げ{受給|じゅきゅう} (delayed pension receipt)

FORMS:
- {繰|く}り{下|さ}げる (to move down, to postpone)
- {繰|く}り{下|さ}がる (to be moved down - intransitive)

PENSION CONTEXT:
In Japan, {繰|く}り{下|さ}げ specifically refers to delaying the start of pension payments (past age 65), which increases the monthly amount.

REGISTER: Neutral. Used in business, academic, and everyday contexts.
